threads.body: The pinned Anthropic 1.11.0 SDK models `server_tool_use` with both `web_fetch_requests` and `web_search_requests` as required integers. Returning only the latter produces an incomplete API payload and can leave SDK consumers without the required field; report zero fetches here as the real response schema does.
